summary: Implemented the window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod, which passes one two-item tuple. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor; it checks only is_terminal and returns True or False. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch that calls term.set_title with the title text. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_control_title, test_set_window_title in test_console.py (skipped on win32), and test_set_window_title in test_windows_renderer.py (mocked wrapper). Tests, mypy and Black were not run, per instructions; all verification was by reading. Nothing was committed.
